title: cullen stipulaceum
intro: Cullen stipulaceum, commonly known as Lesser St John's Wort or Wild St John's Wort, is a flowering plant native to tropical and subtropical regions. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Cullen stipulaceum include its ability to act as an adaptogen, improving the body's response to stress, and its potential to enhance cognitive function and memory. The bioactive constituents of Cullen stipulaceum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
